# ContextPorter

ContextPorter is an independent Chrome extension for intentionally attaching browser context to messages sent to a user-selected AI provider from Chrome's Side Panel.

Official pages:
- Home: https://ademisler.github.io/contextporter.github.io/
- How it works: https://ademisler.github.io/contextporter.github.io/how-it-works/
- Privacy: https://ademisler.github.io/contextporter.github.io/privacy/
- Support: https://ademisler.github.io/contextporter.github.io/support/
- Terms: https://ademisler.github.io/contextporter.github.io/terms/

Key product facts:
- No ContextPorter application backend.
- Browser context is user-selected and sent to the chosen supported AI provider.
- Local screenshots/files are stored in extension-owned IndexedDB with bounded retention.
- ContextPorter is not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or xAI.
